I cannot say enough about how great this place is! The entire team and especially Dr. Díez he is extremely knowledgeable and shows genuine concern for my dog. My dog was vomiting in addition to diarrhea with blood and was diagnosed with enterocolitis. They gave her shots and pills for the next 10 days and my dog is on the path to a full recovery! The entire team is very loving and they do not push or do any unnecessary tests to drive up your bill like other places do. It's hard to find good doctors and people these days that show genuine love and concern for people's pets! This place is like heaven sent!

I don’t trust these people. They give you “cheaper” treatments that aren’t going to work “to save you money” only for them to not work and then have to get the “more expensive” treatments as well. They may seem cheaper than other vets, but once you get the treatment you actually need, you’re paying about the same as just going to an expensive vet. If you aren’t so familiar with veterinary medicine, you wouldn’t be aware of the game they’re playing. Go elsewhere. I regret trusting them.

I just wanted to share a heartfelt thank you to Dr. Diaz and everyone at Carballo Animal Clinic for the many years of care they gave my sweet Duke. Duke became their patient when he was just 2 months old and was part of their family ever since. He originally saw Dr. Carballo, and after his retirement, Dr. Diaz continued to take such good care of him through every stage of his life.

The love and attention Duke received at this clinic meant so much to me. The staff always pampered him with hugs, kisses, and so many treats—he absolutely loved it. He even knew exactly which closet the treats were kept in and made a beeline for it every time we visited.

Duke passed away on June 24th at 11 years old, and I’m still heartbroken. But knowing he had such a caring team looking after him all these years brings me a lot of comfort. Thank you, Dr. Diaz and team, for loving him, for helping him, and for making every visit a happy one for my boy. You were such a special part of his life, and we’ll never forget it.

My princess Raya was a patient of them since she was 8 weeks old. I held this veterinary with high regard and full trust. Over the years the quality and dedication from this vet diminished greatly! My Raya passed away at only 3 years old. Before she passed away I reached out to her “vet” with my concerns and I got mediocre care, not even a call back from her vet. The compassion and kindness was nonexistent. I was told by the front desk person a supposed message from Raya’s vet. I followed what was prescribed. I called that Monday asking if Raya can be seen and I was told they were too busy - later that day I took Raya to St Frances ER where my Raya took her last breath. I never got a follow up call from her vet to see if she was ok. They called days later to remind me that she has an appt for vaccines. This made me breakdown and I felt so betrayed. I would never recommend this vet for anyone who truly loves their pet and wants the best care. Please read and do your research when choosing a vet for the care of your baby.

Awful experience.
After bringing my Yorkie Benji, here for over 3 years, today Doctor Carballo entered the room unannounced went to pet my dog and my dog barked loudly yet never bit nor has ever bitten anyone. The Doctor assumed I knew the dog would jump and bark loudly, and said I would be liable for any harm my dog would cause. Mind you this doctor has never cared for my dog, the other doctor Diaz has, and my dog has never had a negative interaction. Carballo spoke in a loud tone, said he was not an animal tamer, that he was a doctor. I am aware that I am liable for any danger or harm my dog causes, yet he did not cause any harm. Doctor Carballo’s tone and attitude was uncalled for because  he deals with animals, a bite or any reaction from an animal is an inherent risk he has assumed given his profession. Doctor Carballo made me feel extremely uncomfortable, there is no need to spend money at a place that the owner feels entitled to treat clients in such a grotesque manner. The Doctor’s assistant felt extremely uncomfortable with the Doctor’s reaction, even asked me if I wanted to terminate the visit at that time. In conclusion of the visit, the doctor said he was sorry, but the bad experience I had just undergone was unbearable. Nothing else was done to amend the situation. If you want to experience an easy going vet visit and a welcoming Doctor, don’t you ever go to Doctor Carballo.
